name: [UPD] Steal A Deadly Rails
desc:
Made by the biggest fans of Dead Rails 
Big shout out to RiccoMiller!!!

Game Update Log 🌟
- 🐉 NEW LIMITED MOBS!
- 🔄 2 NEW Rebirths!
- 🧪 Potion Dealer! [OP Mutation Potions ...]

🎭 Welcome to Steal a Deadly Rails 🎭
💀 Collect powerful mobs and earn Bounds!
🧠 Defend your stash from other players!
👣 Sneak into enemy bases and steal their mobs!

[How to Play]
• Buy mobs that appear through the tunnel
• Add them to your collection to generate Bounds
• Visit other players to see their mob stash
• Steal rare mobs and dominate the leaderboard!
